params.body:
Fixes the issues from pi-action's review of `present` (https://github.com/cv/pit/issues/372#issuecomment-6872140566) and releases v0.36.5.

1. `call()` never returns an empty title: label, else the program's first line, else `functionId`, else `typescript`.
2. `saveOnly` summaries use a string `savedFunction`, else `functionId`, else the declared function name, else no summary.
3. `result()` and `call()` accept non-object details, non-array content, non-string code, and non-object args, falling back to the result text.
4. Question results are summarized as `asked: <title>`.

Each case has a test in `test/durable/present.test.ts`. check, tests, coverage, and package:check pass locally.
